subject: Vendr manifest: signed proof-of-possession & delegated upload window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-payments.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr manifest: signed proof-of-possession & delegated upload window

Hi Marta / Vendr team,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. As discussed, Acme needs our evidence handoff to include a signed manifest that proves possession of the files we reference in the Vendr profile (CAIQ sections and SOC2 attachments). To make the ingestion deterministic on your side, we'd like to: 

- Provide a signed SHA256 manifest listing S3 paths and object ETags (attached: vendr_manifest_v1.json and signed_manifest.sha256.sig).
- Provide an S3 ACL snapshot for the objects we expect you to ingest (attached: s3_acl_snapshot.txt).
- Open a delegated upload window (API token or SFTP creds) for exactly 48 hours starting next Wednesday 4/21 09:00 PT so your platform can pull the objects and verify checksums.

Can you confirm Vendr's preferred ingestion method (SFTP vs temporary API token with scoped read-only permissions)? If you prefer an API token we'll need the exact required IAM policy so we can limit scope. If SFTP, confirm hostname, username pattern, and whether you support GPG-wrapped uploads.

I'm CC'ing Ben (platform security) and Irene (evidence ops) to prep the ACLs and perform a quick preflight so we don't inadvertently expose any unrelated buckets. Once you confirm the method and window we'll hand off the signed manifest via DocuSign envelope for audit trail.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments: vendr_manifest_v1.json (manifest), signed_manifest.sha256.sig (signature), s3_acl_snapshot.txt (ACL snapshot)
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-payments.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.io>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr manifest: signed proof-of-possession & delegated upload window

Hi Naomi — thanks for the note and attachments. This workflow looks good and aligns with our intake requirements. A few clarifying points before we schedule the window: 

1) Vendr prefers a short-lived API token for automated ingestion (we support scoped tokens that can be limited to a single S3 prefix). SFTP is supported but has higher operational overhead.
2) Please provide the exact S3 prefix(es) and the IAM policy you plan to attach; Vendr will generate a scoped token mapping to that prefix.
3) We need the signed manifest to include per-file last-modified timestamps in ISO8601 so our dedupe logic can validate freshness.

If you can send the ACL snapshot and a DocuSign link for the signed manifest consent, we can provision the token and target 48-hour window starting 2027-04-21T09:00:00-07:00 as proposed. Also copying Vendr Support to confirm token rotation TTL and scoping behavior.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of InfoSec Programs
Acme Payments
marta.lopez@acme-payments.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr manifest: signed proof-of-possession & delegated upload window

Quick internal note:

Naomi — I'll prep the IAM policy snippet and a single-prefix role for Vendr's scoped token. Irene, can you run an ACL diff and strip any cross-account grants from the listed objects? The s3_acl_snapshot.txt I generated includes both canonical IDs and email grants; we should normalize to canonical IDs for the manifest.

Karthik — once Ben posts the IAM policy I'll need you to coordinate with Infra to create the temporary role and set an inline policy with the exact GetObject, ListBucket scope and prefix condition. Also, we should hash the manifest with our existing sig pipeline (vendr_manifest_v1.json -> signed_manifest.sha256.sig). I'll attach the IAM snippet to the HubSpot ticket and ping Infra.

Thanks — planning to deliver ACL-cleaned snapshot and IAM snippet by EOD 4/19.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr manifest: signed proof-of-possession & delegated upload window

Marta / Vendr team —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Next steps and artifacts (summarized):

- Infra/IAM: Ben/Karthik will publish a limited policy and role for the prefix s3://redwood-evidence/acme-payments/2027-04-manifest/. Ben will paste the policy to HubSpot ticket CRM-88431 when ready.
- Evidence ops: Irene will normalize ACLs (remove public/cross-account grants) and regenerate s3_acl_snapshot.txt; she will also append ISO8601 last-modified timestamps to vendr_manifest_v1.json before re-signing.
- DocuSign: I'll send a DocuSign envelope with the signed manifest consent; please sign so we have audit trail. Link will include the signed manifest and the S3 prefix statement.
- Token window: Target 2027-04-21T09:00:00-07:00 to 2027-04-23T09:00:00-07:00. Vendr Support, please confirm token TTL and whether the token can be pinned to a Job ID for our audit logs.

Marta, after you confirm the token approach we'll schedule a 20-minute sync to walk through ingestion expectations (checksums, dedupe, CAIQ section mapping).
